improvements: Strict Gregorian timezone-aware publication clocks preserve the existing four-hour display window and five-minute future grace without Date.parse calendar normalization.

Identified engine, schema and explicit research-only permissions are required. Sample counts, dates, minimum, quality reasons, capital status and typed measurements must agree; missing metadata never becomes measured zero.

A reconciled label requires positive finite USD NAV, no capital errors and an available holdings model. The UI calls it model-reported and distinguishes metadata validation from independent account/input verification.

All four genuine synthetic native outputs remain usable: no NAV, measured zero holdings risk, reported reconciled NAV and incomplete inputs. Native calculations and account access policy are unchanged.

Failed loads clear prior snapshot timestamps, counts and sector summaries; the correlation panel becomes visible again when a later multi-instrument result arrives. Scenario navigation points to the existing portfolio/index.html route.

browser_acceptance.scope: Original portfolio HTML and helper with wholly synthetic in-memory responses, external connections denied by CSP and no authentication bootstrap.
browser_acceptance.measured_zero: Holdings VaR $0, volatility 0.00%, beta per gross 0.00; account VaR remains unavailable without NAV.
browser_acceptance.reported_nav: Synthetic USD NAV 2000; model VaR $9.31 / 0.47%, beta 0.50, annual volatility 3.2%.
browser_acceptance.invalid_nav: Visible reconciliation-status rejection; prior risk cards, alerts and holdings risk summary cleared; separately received snapshot remains visible.
browser_acceptance.failure: Prior timestamp and counts cleared, all risk metrics unavailable; keyboard Enter recovered the incomplete packet.

limitations: Exact static deployment is pending. No authenticated account session or actual portfolio is inspected.

The checks validate supplied model metadata, not the identity or completeness of the account book, market sources, NAV reconciliation or risk forecast skill. Snapshot/risk generation binding and complete transport validation remain separate work.
All ten platform workstreams remain open; this repair grants no Calls, sizing or execution authority.
